snippet.title: Idosra: The Electric Renaissance Launch Announcement
snippet.description:
Idosra is launching November 2025 after five years in development! Idosra is a hybrid RPG/platformer that takes place in the far future of North Carolina.

Wishlist on Steam to be notified of the launch discount!

https://www.idosra.com/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2808350/Idosra_The_Electric_Renaissance/
